text:
maria: kicking off POC onboarding for Acme Analytics — 4 week POC, they want Hosted API keys for initial integration, then a Private VPC pilot for data isolation. Need a concise provisioning runbook we can hand to SEs and infra.
ajay: noted. timeline and success criteria?
maria: timeline = 4 weeks. success = integration + 100 req/s sustained for 10m on our dedicated profile OR passing privacy review for VPC option.
sam: I'll own infra steps for private. Quick checklist idea below.
sophie: I can triage security questionnaire items — need to know which KMS + audit options they require.
ben: I'll validate model quotas and dedicated pool sizing estimates.
kori: SE will need hosted API keys and sample prompts to replicate latency. Also flag any pricing constraints for the account.
ajay: proposing runbook sections: 1) Pre-PoC intake (contacts, SOW, data classification) 2) Hosted API quickstart 3) VPC/private setup 4) Dedicated pool trial 5) Handoff + rollback
maria: yes. keep hosted path minimal: API key creation, example curl, sample env vars, token limits.
sam: Private/VPC runbook (high level):
- Customer provides CIDR and peering contact
- Create customer VPC peering (or AWS PrivateLink) -> note IP allowlist
- Provision subnets in us-west-2 (match customer's region) if requested
- Configure firewall: allow outbound to our control plane on 443
- Configure KMS key binding (customer key ARN optional)
- Create service account and generate service certs
- Run connectivity test

kori: can you drop the actual commands? small snippets help SEs.
sam: sure — example VPN test:
```
# from customer bastion
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.internal/health --resolve "api.redwood-inference.internal:443:10.2.4.5"
```
and for hosted API key creation (SE flow):
```
# create API key via console (click) or CLI
rwctl keys create --project acme-poc --role inference:client
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

sophie: security FAQ we should pre-fill: data retention policy, encryption at rest/in transit, who can access logs, SOC2 status, vulnerability disclosure. I'll draft answers and attach to ticket.
ben: sizing notes: for 100 req/s typical prompt (avg 60 tokens) — estimate 8 A100-equivalent GPU dedicated pool with continuous batching. If they want lower cost, suggest int8 quantized variant and concurrency tuning.
ajay: pricing note for proposal: show hosted estimate (per-token) for baseline integration week + dedicated monthly reserve for trial (30 days pro-rated). include overage fallback to hosted to avoid downtime.
maria: ok owners: sam (private infra), ben (capacity), sophie (security answers), kori (SE liaise). SE will collect contact info and invite infra to customer call Wed.
deploy-bot: env-prov: poc-acme-hosted created by kori at 1993014000
kori: created hosted API key scope and sample prompts in /docs/poc-acme/quickstart (internal).
maria: action items: 1) attach security FAQ draft to GH ticket (#POC-433) 2) sam to post VPC PS steps + runbook snippet 3) ben to send sizing + cost estimate 4) kori to share quickstart link with customer by EOD tomorrow
sophie: will add required questionnaire fields: log retention (30/90/365), KMS option (managed/customer), incident contact, penetration test windows.
ben: I'll include two cost scenarios: conservative (dedicated reserve) and cheap (hosted + autoscale). Will post numbers in Slack and Google sheet.
ajay: SE checklist for customer call: share curl example, ask for CIDR & peering contact, confirm data classification, confirm expected peak qps.
maria: thanks all. try to keep updates in this thread. If we need an infra breakout, sam ping me and I'll start a war room channel.
sam: will post VPC step-by-step in ~2h.
kori: will sync with customer and confirm times. tagging @maria when sent.
maria: perfect — closing for now. :thumbsup:
